summary.en: Three cards stand edge-on, then tumble in 3D along one smooth path into a staggered stair, sharp all the way, and keep turning slowly once they stand.
summary.zh: 三张页卡先侧棱朝前、几乎看不见，再沿一条平滑路径在 3D 里翻飞成错落的阶梯，全程清晰，站定后仍缓慢转动。

fits: Revealing a set of pages, screens or features at once; the opening of a product film; a finale that gathers the cards before they collapse.
notFor: One card (use card-portal or pose-fly); reading the cards' text (they are large but turned); flat or print styles that avoid 3D.

intent.en: A set of pages appears out of nothing and lines up with energy: cards flip in from their thin edges into a stair, showing "many capabilities" at a glance.
intent.zh: 一组页面从无到有、带着冲劲列队：卡片从薄边翻飞成阶梯，一眼看到“好多能力”。

content.en: Wraps exactly three card painters (pages, screens or feature cards); their text is decorative, not read.
content.zh: 包住正好三张卡（页面、屏幕或功能卡）；卡上的字只作装饰，不需要读。

fits.zh: 一次亮出一组页面、屏幕或功能；产品片开场；收尾前把卡片聚拢（flock-finale 接着收束）。

notFor.zh: 只有一张卡（用 pose-fly 或 card-portal）；卡上的字要读（大但斜着）；回避 3D 的平面或印刷风格。

pairs.note: pulls the stair into the title with a smoke ring

en: Never let the cards stop once standing; a still stair at the climax was rejected (keep the slow turn).
No motion blur or defocus: it must stay sharp all the way.
zh: 站定后不许停住；高潮段静止被判不行（保持慢转）。
不加运动模糊或景深糊：全程清晰。

upstream.name: 卡片翻飞收束
upstream.summary: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
upstream.use: 能量高潮段（功能页群→品牌口号的爆点转场）；霓虹/极光暗场调性；"多页面能力"收束成一句话的段落
